تستهجنون (form X)
# تَسْتَهْجِنُونَ (tastahjinūna) /tas.tah.d͡ʒi.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَهْجَنَ (istahjana)
# تُسْتَهْجَنُونَ (tustahjanūna) /tus.tah.d͡ʒa.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَهْجَنَ (istahjana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
